reddit.title: Missile Volleys at Bow Range: A New Era for Combat in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share that our missile troops now operate with more strategy than ever! No longer rushing into melee after the first volley, they hold their ground and engage from a safe distance. Check out the details on how this change enhances gameplay and brings a new layer of strategy to your city-building experience. Read more here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/missile-volleys-at-bow-range?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=missile-volleys-at-bow-range

steam.title: New Combat Mechanics in Provincia: Missile Troops Hold Their Ground
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce a significant update to our combat system! Missile troops in Provincia now maintain a safe distance during battles, allowing for strategic volleys rather than rushing into melee. This change not only enhances realism but also adds a new layer of strategy to your gameplay. Learn more about these exciting updates here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/missile-volleys-at-bow-range?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=missile-volleys-at-bow-range
